title: federation: bad avatar rejects groupUpdate pre-auth
description:
federation-server: a structurally malformed Peer/groupUpdate avatar rejects the whole request before authorization (batch 8b review, JMAP-0x0q.43).

crate-jmap-chat-federation-types/src/peer.rs:618-650: PeerGroupUpdateArgs.avatar is a strict Option<Clearable<PeerAvatar>>. A negative/non-integer size, missing fetchUrl or non-string contentType fails deserialization, so handle_peer_group_update returns invalidArguments before the authorization and closedAt checks.

Spec draft-atwood-jmap-chat-federation-00 L676: "After the authorization and `closedAt` checks above succeed, and only then, if `avatar` is an Object, the receiving server validates `contentType` and `size` ... A failed avatar never causes the request to be rejected." So an authorized update with a bad avatar should apply its other fields, and an unauthorized peer should get the authorization error, not invalidArguments. Fix: deserialize avatar loosely (Value or lenient struct) and validate after authorization; add tests for both orderings (tests/peer_methods.rs:851/928 cover only fetch failures).
close_reason: Batch 9: committed and adversarially verified; CI green at df7e2035
